lead_raw_text:
The structure of BaSm₂N₃ crystallizes in the tetragonal space group P4/mmm (No. 38), with a unit cell containing six atoms distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows nitrogen centers with four geometric neighbors (three Ba, one Sm) at 2.46–2.48 Å, while Sm and Ba each adopt close-packed-like local arrangements with 12 neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all six sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner- and face-sharing between Ba and Sm 12-vertex coordination polyhedra, and edge-sharing among like-centered 12-vertex polyhedra.
